system.longDesc:
These drugs cause powerful hallucinations and make it difficult for the subject to distinguish what is real. Once the drug has taken effect, it requires a TN 13 Constitution

(Tolerance) test for the character to take actions; failure means they are too distracted or caught up in the experience. Even if they succeed, a character on psychotropics has a –2 penalty to their attack rolls and Dexterity, Perception, and Willpower tests. A psychotropic lasts anywhere from an hour to eight hours or more, depending on the drug and the dosage.

Resources TN 9.
